atoms.text: The thorny devil is a lizard that lives in the desert in Australia. Thorny devils may look scary because of their thorns, but are actually quite harmless. They are rather small, growing up to about 10-20 centimetres long. An adult human can easily hold a thorny devil in their hand. The thorny devil’s favourite food is ants. Living in the desert means it can be hard to find water, but thorny devils have a secret trick to stay hydrated. They get droplets of water from plants and sand to land on their skin. Then, through small grooves in their skin, the water flows to their mouth.
